sections.title: INOCULATION AND VACCINATION CERTIFICATES REQUIRED BY VARIOUS COUNTRIES

summary.text: A bilingual French and English notice amending the list of inoculation and vaccination certificates required by various countries, covering Guam in Oceania. It records that plague and typhus certificates are no longer required and that civilian passengers arriving directly from the United States and its territories are exempted from medical and vaccination certificates from February 1951.

sections.extract: CERTIFICATES REQUIRED BY VARIOUS COUNTRIES Amendments of the “ List of Countries’ Inoculation and Vaccination Certificate R equirem ents” as on 61 December 1950 (W HO/Qf28.Rev 1).
